recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下可見成群的紅血球前驅細胞島，其中混有較大、染色質細緻、核仁可見的未成熟紅系母細胞（左移），並散在棕色含鐵血黃素，呼應兒童難治性血球減少症（RCC）常見的紅系左移聚落。
features: Clusters of erythroid precursors ranging from larger immature forms (round nuclei, finer chromatin, small nucleoli, amphophilic cytoplasm) to small dark orthochromatic normoblasts
Left-shifted erythroid islands with increased proportion of immature erythroblasts
Scattered granulocytic cells, fewer in number than erythroid elements in this field
Scattered golden-brown hemosiderin pigment in macrophages
Megakaryocytes not conspicuous in this field; bony trabecula at lower left
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows clusters of erythroid precursors with a relative increase in immature, larger erythroblasts showing finer chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with maturing normoblasts. Granulocytic elements are present but relatively sparse, and scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are seen. Megakaryocytes are not well represented in this field, so micromegakaryocytes cannot be assessed here. Blasts are not increased in this field. In the appropriate clinical context, findings are consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows markedly hypocellular fatty marrow without left-shifted erythroid islands or micromegakaryocytes; residual islands, if present, are small and mature.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure (e.g. Fanconi anemia)
ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap, so chromosomal breakage testing and germline genetic studies are needed to exclude an inherited syndrome.
Megaloblastic anemia shows marked nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes and responds to B12/folate replacement, rather than persistent left-shifted islands with cytopenias.
